name: api_bi_dashboard
_description: ADDENDUM 2 Bloque 7 - Dashboard de Inteligencia de Negocio. GET /api/v1/bi/dashboard devuelve 6 widgets en una sola respuesta: rentabilidad, fases (placeholder), conversion, agentes_activos_mes, alertas_presupuesto, prediccion_carga. Multi-tenant via RLS + tenant_id del JWT.
_response_shape: { ok: true, data: { rentabilidad, fases, conversion, agentes_activos_mes, alertas_presupuesto, prediccion_carga } }

parameters.query:
WITH
  rentabilidad AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) AS data FROM (
      SELECT project_id, project_name, status, margen_eur, margen_pct
        FROM v_bi_project_profitability
       WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid
       ORDER BY margen_pct DESC NULLS LAST
       LIMIT 10
    ) t
  ),
  fases AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) AS data FROM (
      SELECT phase, n_proyectos, dias_medios
        FROM v_bi_phase_duration
       WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid
    ) t
  ),
  conversion AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY mes ASC) AS data FROM (
      SELECT mes, enviadas, aceptadas, tasa_pct
        FROM v_bi_proposal_conversion
       WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid
       ORDER BY mes DESC
       LIMIT 6
    ) t
  ),
  agentes AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) AS data FROM (
      SELECT agent_name, ejecuciones
        FROM v_bi_agent_activity_month
       WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid
       ORDER BY ejecuciones DESC
       LIMIT 10
    ) t
  ),
  alertas AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) AS data FROM (
      SELECT project_id, name, desviacion_pct
        FROM v_bi_budget_alerts
       WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid
       ORDER BY desviacion_pct DESC
       LIMIT 10
    ) t
  ),
  carga AS (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY semana_iso ASC) AS data FROM (
      SELECT date_trunc('week', s.day)::date AS semana_iso,
             count(p.*)::int AS proyectos_activos
        FROM generate_series(now()::date, (now() + interval '30 days')::date, '7 days') s(day)
        LEFT JOIN projects p
          ON p.tenant_id = $1::uuid
         AND p.status IN ('active','paused','blocked')
         AND p.started_at IS NOT NULL
         AND p.started_at::date <= s.day
         AND (p.completed_at IS NULL OR p.completed_at::date >= s.day)
       GROUP BY s.day
    ) t
  )
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM rentabilidad), '[]'::json) AS rentabilidad,
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM fases),        '[]'::json) AS fases,
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM conversion),   '[]'::json) AS conversion,
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM agentes),      '[]'::json) AS agentes_activos_mes,
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM alertas),      '[]'::json) AS alertas_presupuesto,
  COALESCE((SELECT data FROM carga),        '[]'::json) AS prediccion_carga

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, data: { rentabilidad: $json.rentabilidad || [], fases: $json.fases || [], conversion: $json.conversion || [], agentes_activos_mes: $json.agentes_activos_mes || [], alertas_presupuesto: $json.alertas_presupuesto || [], prediccion_carga: $json.prediccion_carga || [] }, meta: { request_id: $('Decode JWT').first().json.request_id, generated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}
